ex: His cheek smelled of aftershave and stale tobacco.
他的脸颊闻到须后水和陈旧的烟草味。

en: a small earthquake that happens after a bigger one
ex: The area suffered a series of aftershocks measuring up to 6.3 on the Richter scale.
该地区遭受了一系列余震，最高可达里氏6.3级。

zh: cream, etc. that you put on your skin after you have been out in the sun
en: cream, etc. that you put on your skin after you have been out in the sun

zh: （饮食留在口中不快的）回味，余味，苦味
en: a taste (usually an unpleasant one) that stays in your mouth after you have eaten or drunk something
ex: The whole experience, though enjoyable enough at the time, left a bitter aftertaste.
整个体验虽然在当时足够令人愉悦，但却留下了苦涩的回味。

zh: 事后想法，事后添加的事物（常未经周密考虑）
en: a thing that is thought of, said or added later, and is often not carefully planned
ex: They only invited Jack and Sarah as an afterthought.
他们后来才想到邀请杰克和萨拉。

en: at a later time; after an event that has already been mentioned
ex: Afterwards she was sorry for what she'd said.
后来她后悔说了那些话。

en: a section at the end of a book that says something about the main text, and may be written by a different author

zh: （对他人的话作出反应或表示生气、恼怒）唔，啊，哎呀
en: used when you are reacting to something that has been said, or when you are angry or annoyed by something
ex: Ag, don't worry about it.
哦，别担心。

en: one more time; on another occasion
ex: This must never happen again.
这种事再也不能发生了。

en: opposing or disagreeing with somebody/something
ex: the fight against terrorism
反对恐怖主义的斗争
